items.title: Surjectivity of the map on spectra is equivalent to the contraction of extended ideals being the ideals themselves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four equivalent conditions for surjectivity of the map on spectra of a ring map: the radical of an extended ideal contracts back, radical ideals contract back, primes do, and the map on spectra is onto, and it adds that the property is stable under base change (statement lines 6038-6054). The proof does not work with the topology on the spectra: it chains the algebra on radicals and inverse images, uses that radical ideals are intersections of primes, translates the prime condition into membership in the image, and then proves base change stability by a residue field computation (proof lines 6056-6086). The rewriting of the tensor product with a residue field is the step carrying the base change part. H2.
